coverage_gaps.description: Halkbank and Centralna kooperativna banka lack a confirmed dated notice channel; Silk Road's channel is a query-string CMS with no confirmed feed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Manually browse each site's Macedonian navigation ('Новости', 'Соопштенија', 'Известувања', 'За банката') and record exact notice-index URLs; fall back to scheduled PDF-diff of tariff/terms documents where no index exists.

coverage_gaps.description: The full licensed-bank and savings-house universe was not enumerated in this pass; the cell brief's ten-bank list may omit smaller institutions and savings houses (штедилници) that also publish terms amendments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBRSM list of licensed banks and savings houses and the MSE listed-issuer index to close the roster, then map each to a notice URL.

coverage_gaps.description: The MK Pillar-3 artefact ('Извештај и податоци за Банката', per the NBRSM decision on disclosure of data and information) was confirmed only for TTK and partially for Stopanska and CCB; per-bank canonical URLs for the remaining banks are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-bank site-scoped search on the exact phrase 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' plus 'објавување на податоци и информации' and record the annual publication path and typical publication month (~May for 31.12 reference date).

coverage_gaps.description: SEI-NET's search/listing mechanics (how to enumerate announcements by issuer and date, whether an open listing endpoint exists) were not established; only opaque document/file IDs were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect seinet.com.mk Page.aspx parameters and the mse.mk per-issuer RSS payload to determine a stable, low-risk enumeration route before building a collector.

coverage_gaps.description: The 'consultations' topic is thinly served by this cell: banks respond to consultations mainly through the banking association rather than individually, and no association consultation-response publications were located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the Macedonian Banking Association / Economic Chamber banking group as a separate actor and check whether industry comment letters on NBRSM drafts are published.

brief: For North Macedonia, individual banks are a rich but fragmented source layer: there is no consolidated register of customer notices, so regulatory change must be observed bank-by-bank through Macedonian-language 'Соопштенија/Известувања' pages, tariff and General Terms PDFs carrying explicit effective dates, and the annual 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' (the local Pillar-3 disclosure). The single highest-leverage node is the MSE/SEI-NET disclosure stack, where every listed bank — Komercijalna, Stopanska, UNI, TTK, Centralna kooperativna, Silk Road and others — must file audited results, capital measures and assembly decisions, and where mse.mk offers a per-issuer RSS feed that makes filings machine-discoverable. Sparkasse is the cleanest template for the cell's target artefact, bundling the statutory fee report with dated tariff and General Terms amendments on a date-structured URL; Halkbank, CCB and Silk Road lack a confirmed notice index and will likely need document-diff monitoring instead. English-language material is effectively absent, and trade outlets bankarstvo.mk and pari.com.mk serve best as discovery pointers back to the banks' own primary documents.
